resources.name: PySCF (or equivalent quantum chemistry code with ROHF)
resources.notes: Open-source quantum chemistry software that supports restricted open-shell Hartree-Fock, pseudopotentials, dipole moments, and external electric fields.

resources.name: Hay–Wadt pseudopotential parameters and basis sets

access.notes: The pseudopotential and basis set data can be obtained from the original publication (Hay & Wadt, J. Chem. Phys. 82, 270 (1985)) or from standard basis set libraries.

resources.notes: The paper specifies the contracted basis set notations: Hg (3s3p3d/2s1p2d), halogen (4s4p1d/3s3p1d).

resources.name: Experimental mercury lattice geometry

access.notes: The mercury crystal structure data (e.g., lattice constant, nearest-neighbor distance) needed to construct the Hg7 cluster. Referenced as [17,18] in the paper. Accessible via standard crystallographic databases or literature.

resources.notes: The geometry of the finite cluster model uses a central Hg atom surrounded by its six nearest neighbours in the first layer, keeping the experimental Hg–Hg distance.
